summary: Fix correctly resolves urlconf before caching, so calls with None and explicit ROOT_URLCONF hit the same cache entry, eliminating duplicate URLResolver construction. Change is minimal, targeted, and updates the one other call site (clear_url_caches) that referenced the old cache handle.

issues.description: get_resolver is no longer itself lru_cache-decorated (cache now lives on private _get_cached_resolver), so any external code calling get_resolver.cache_clear()/cache_info() directly would break. Low risk since it's an internal-ish API and the one in-tree call site was updated.
New private helper _get_cached_resolver duplicates the urlconf=None default param even though it's always called with a resolved urlconf; harmless but slightly redundant.
